packageRules.description: windows-core ships in lockstep with the `windows` crate and is not adoptable on its own. `windows` is at 0.62.x; windows-core has run ahead to 0.100. Taking it alone leaves the DirectWrite interfaces from `windows` implementing a different windows_core::Interface, so the trait bound is unsatisfied and IDWriteTextRenderer's methods stop matching (MDEDIT-189, PR #198). Raise this bound when `windows` itself moves, and move both crates in one PR. crates/shell-win/Cargo.toml says the same thing about `windows`, for the same reason.
